expectedFailures.reason: RTI CORE-14660: RTI 7.3.1 stores a negative int8 union discriminator as unsigned (label -128 becomes 128). Managed DynamicData branch lookup fails, and interpreted C# serialization loses the selected payload. Only the negative-value fixture is affected; RTI C++ self-exchange passes. Fixed in RTI 7.6.0: https://community.rti.com/static/documentation/connext-dds/7.7.0.1/doc/manuals/connext_dds_professional/release_notes/whats_fixed/760/fixes_dynamic_data.html
